say:3:1320801002:1.text: I'm right here! You don't need to yell in my ear. Can't you just say what you want to say?
say:3:1320801002:1.source_cn: 我在这里！不要一遍遍叫我名字，你就不能把想说的先说出来吗？

say:4:1320801003:1.text: This is the official procedure. I need to make sure you're listening to me first. Should we check the other ice mining locations?
say:4:1320801003:1.source_cn: 这是流程！我必须先确保你在听我讲话！我们要不要再去确认...

say:5:1320801004:1.text: No, we cannot leave the area if an accident occurs. That's also a part of the official procedure.
say:5:1320801004:1.source_cn: 不，遇到意外不能擅离工作区，这是规定！

choice_prompt:6:1320801004.text: No, we cannot leave the area if an accident occurs. That's also a part of the official procedure.
choice_prompt:6:1320801004.source_cn: 不，遇到意外不能擅离工作区，这是规定！

say:8:1320801007:1.text: We were assigned here to dig for ice for sculpture-making, but the ice here has already been mined.
say:8:1320801007:1.source_cn: 我们被指派来挖冰块制作冰雕，但指定区域的坚冰已经被采过了。
say:8:1320801007:1.male: We were assigned here to dig for ice for sculpture-making, but the ice here has already been mined.
say:8:1320801007:1.female: We were assigned here to dig for ice for sculpture-making, but the ice here has already been mined.

say:9:1320801008:1.text: You didn't tell them the worst part. The ice sculpture is already finished! I was so looking forward to relaxing and sipping some spiced goat milk after our delivery, but now everything's gone topsy-turvy!
say:9:1320801008:1.source_cn: 你没说清楚最糟糕的，那就是冰雕已经完成了！我还等着交付...

say:11:1320801009:1.text: Ice sculpture... Do you mean the ice sculpture used for the ceremony?
say:11:1320801009:1.source_cn: 冰雕……你们是说庆典上最后要用的冰雕？

say:12:1320801010:1.text: Which other one is there? We had improved our production process, optimized our procedures, and were all set to outdo our past work, but by the time we got there, the ice sculpture was already done!
say:12:1320801010:1.source_cn: 不然还有哪个？我们好不容易改进了制作工艺，优化流程，准...

say:13:1320801011:1.text: Wait... isn't that a good thing? Your job's done, so you don't need to worry about anything.
say:13:1320801011:1.source_cn: 呃……这不是好事吗？你们的工作已经完成，不用再赶工了。

say:17:1320801014:1.text: This is a huge slip-up! Think about it! Something that wasn't supposed to be done is now done. We have to figure out which part of the process went wrong, or else more mistakes may be compounded later.
say:17:1320801014:1.source_cn: 本来没有做完的东西，现在却做完了，这是难以忍受的巨大纰...

say:18:1320801015:1.text: Our construction records are never wrong, and we don't have a written record of a completed ice sculpture. People's memories are unreliable, so we must trust the paperwork.
say:18:1320801015:1.source_cn: 施工记录是不可能出错的，我们没有完成雕像的书面记录，记...

say:20:1320801017:1.text: Ah, I'll show you. Tory, take out the records!
say:20:1320801017:1.source_cn: 唉，给你们看看记录吧，托瑞，把东西拿出来！

say:22:1320801018:1.text: The records should be in my backpack. Folded thrice and wrapped in cowhide.
say:22:1320801018:1.source_cn: 记录在背包里，折了三叠，用牛皮纸包着。

say:23:1320801019:1.text: I can't take my hand off my pick! Gotta keep working! How about you take it out yourself and take a look, my mage friend?
say:23:1320801019:1.source_cn: 我的手不能离开矿镐，也不方便啊！这位魔法师朋友，你自己...
say:23:1320801019:1.male: I can't take my hand off my pick! Gotta keep working! How about you take it out yourself and take a look, my mage friend?
say:23:1320801019:1.female: I can't take my hand off my pick! Gotta keep working! How about you take it out yourself and take a look, my mage friend?

say:25:1320801006:1.text: Ha! That's funny! No, it's worse than that.
say:25:1320801006:1.source_cn: 哈，我喜欢这玩笑！不过我们遇到的更离谱！
say:25:1320801006:1.male: Ha! That's funny! No, it's worse than that.
say:25:1320801006:1.female: Ha! That's funny! No, it's worse than that.

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你们不会把矿洞搞塌了吧

say:0:1320802001:0.text: Found it! So this is the construction record!
say:0:1320802001:0.source_cn: 找到了，这就是施工记录！

say:1:1320803001:1.text: You saw that the ice sculpture's already been put up, meaning the carving's all done, but we're still in the middle of harvesting the ice.
say:1:1320803001:1.source_cn: 你看，现在外面的冰雕已经立好，说明最后一步雕刻加工已经...
say:1:1320803001:1.male: You saw that the ice sculpture's already been put up, meaning the carving's all done, but we're still in the middle of harvesting the ice.
say:1:1320803001:1.female: You saw that the ice sculpture's already been put up, meaning the carving's all done, but we're still in the middle of harvesting the ice.

say:2:1320803002:1.text: But how's this possible? What went wrong? How could there be such a huge hole in our records?
say:2:1320803002:1.source_cn: 这怎么可能呢？哪一步环节出错了？我们的工作记录怎么会出...
say:2:1320803002:1.male: But how's this possible? What went wrong? How could there be such a huge hole in our records?
say:2:1320803002:1.female: But how's this possible? What went wrong? How could there be such a huge hole in our records?

choice_prompt:3:1320803002.text: But how's this possible? What went wrong? How could there be such a huge hole in our records?
choice_prompt:3:1320803002.source_cn: 这怎么可能呢？哪一步环节出错了？我们的工作记录怎么会出这么大的漏洞？
choice_prompt:3:1320803002.male: But how's this possible? What went wrong? How could there be such a huge hole in our records?
choice_prompt:3:1320803002.female: But how's this possible? What went wrong? How could there be such a huge hole in our records?

say:4:1320803003:0.text: So what if there is magic? Magic can't bypass our rules and regulations!
say:4:1320803003:0.source_cn: 魔法又如何，魔法也不能破坏我们的规则制度！
say:4:1320803003:0.male: So what if there is magic? Magic can't bypass our rules and regulations!
say:4:1320803003:0.female: So what if there is magic? Magic can't bypass our rules and regulations!

say:6:1320803004:1.text: There's no need to be such a stickler for the rules... Since the job is done, can you just fill in what happened on the official record?
say:6:1320803004:1.source_cn: 各位，我想也许没必要这么死板……既然工作已经完成，只要...

say:9:1320803006:1.text: Listen, we have our own regulations. Slips in the process are way more embarrassing than leaving a job or two unfinished!
say:9:1320803006:1.source_cn: 我们有自己的规矩，流程上的疏漏可远比完不成一两件工作的...

say:10:1320803007:1.text: Oh, really? The dwarves I know aren't as inflexible as you are.
say:10:1320803007:1.source_cn: 哦，是吗？我认识的矮人可不全像你们这样死板。

say:11:1320803008:1.text: Is that so? Have you met any dwarves like that, Tory?

say:13:1320803009:1.text: Nope! That's like saying people don't like spiced goat milk!
say:13:1320803009:1.source_cn: 没有！我倒是见过不爱喝羊奶的。

say:14:1320803010:1.text: It's true! We know a dwarf named Hugin. He loves inventing new things and doesn't care much for keeping to some old rules and doing the same things over and over.
say:14:1320803010:1.source_cn: 是真的呢，他叫呼金！他最喜欢做的事就是不断发明新东西，...

say:15:1320803011:1.text: Wait... did you just say Hugin?

say:16:1320803012:1.text: Do you mean Hugin the Master Planner?
say:16:1320803012:1.source_cn: 你说那个呼金？“规划师”呼金？

say:18:1320803013:1.text: No way! This whole production line was planned by him!
say:18:1320803013:1.source_cn: 哈，这绝不可能！因为这个计划就是他制定的！

choice_prompt:19:1320803013.text: No way! This whole production line was planned by him!
choice_prompt:19:1320803013.source_cn: 哈，这绝不可能！因为这个计划就是他制定的！

say:20:1320803014:1.text: Of course! Everyone from senior engineers to junior apprentices know of Hugin! He even made the designs for the neighborhood we live in.
say:20:1320803014:1.source_cn: 当然，从高级工程师到这里的学徒都知道他。他还亲自给我们...

say:21:1320803015:1.text: Are you saying that this whole set of procedures was formulated by Hugin?
say:21:1320803015:1.source_cn: 唔，你们说，这一整套足可以吓死人的流程……是呼金制定的？

say:22:1320803016:1.text: Yeah, we wouldn't lie about something like this.

say:23:1320803017:1.text: Okay, don't move. Let's have all the work stop for now. We'll go find Hugin and get some answers.
say:23:1320803017:1.source_cn: 你们……你们先不要动，就当停工，我们去找呼金问个清楚。

say:25:1320803018:1.text: Well, if it's an order for work stoppage, there needs to be a formal notice signed by both the construction team leader and a safety inspector.
say:25:1320803018:1.source_cn: 停工要有正式的书面通知，而且需要施工队长和安检员签字说明——

say:26:1320803019:1.text: Alright, got it. We'll go find Hugin first. You guys can...
say:26:1320803019:1.source_cn: 知道了，我们先去找呼金聊聊，你们，呃……

say:27:1320803020:1.text: ...just do something that follows the official procedures.
say:27:1320803020:1.source_cn: 随便做点什么“合乎流程”的事好了！

say:28:1320803021:1.text: You don't need to tell us that. We just want to do a good job without disrupting the process, you know. However, if something unexpected happens, it's gotta be resolved.
say:28:1320803021:1.source_cn: 那当然，工作是第一位的！大家都希望不破坏流程的前提干好...

say:30:1320803022:1.text: Thanks for the help. Say hello to Hugin for us!
say:30:1320803022:1.source_cn: 那就有劳了，代我们向呼金问好！

choice:19:1:2.text: That's a heck of a title.
choice:19:1:2.male: That's a heck of a title.
choice:19:1:2.female: That's a heck of a title.

choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 天下矮人是一家，我早该想到

choice:3:1:2.text: You did the work. I know you did.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 确实是你们做完的，我可以保证
choice:3:1:2.male: You did the work. I know you did.
choice:3:1:2.female: You did the work. I know you did.

say:0:1320804001:0.text: Chippy can't understand guys like that...
say:0:1320804001:0.source_cn: 真是无法理解他们的想法……

say:1:1320804002:0.text: Yeah, let's go find Hugin and see what he has to say.
say:1:1320804002:0.source_cn: 是呢，不过我们先去找呼金，看看他怎么说吧。

say:1:1320806001:1.text: Ha! Magister! What brings you here today?
say:1:1320806001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，什么风把你给吹来啦！
say:1:1320806001:1.male: Ha! Magister! What brings you here today?
say:1:1320806001:1.female: Ha! Magister! What brings you here today?

say:2:1320806002:1.text: Don't mind us. What are you doing here, Hugin?
say:2:1320806002:1.source_cn: 呼金，你在这里干什么呢？

say:3:1320806003:1.text: Just checking the craftsmanship of this sculpture. You know that Cedartown's been acting mighty strange lately, right? Some say the festival's over. Others swear it hasn't begun. Everyone is as addled as a rock gnome on a bender.
say:3:1320806003:1.source_cn: 检查工艺。之前雪松镇上有些奇怪的事情，这几天大家都过得...

say:4:1320806004:1.text: This here sculpture is definitely the work of my brethren and I. It couldn't be from any other hands. Yet, if we carved such a splendid creation, how is it we don't remember it?
say:4:1320806004:1.source_cn: 这雕像明明白白是我和同胞的手艺，不可能出自别人之手。但...

say:5:1320806005:1.text: It's just as well you all came. I could do with a mage's keen eye to shed light on the mystery of this carving.
say:5:1320806005:1.source_cn: 正好，你们可以用魔法师的眼光帮我确认确认，这座雕像到底...
say:5:1320806005:1.male: It's just as well you all came. I could do with a mage's keen eye to shed light on the mystery of this carving.
say:5:1320806005:1.female: It's just as well you all came. I could do with a mage's keen eye to shed light on the mystery of this carving.

say:6:1320806006:1.text: What's wrong with it? <style="stress"><player_name></style> even helped to make the Ignis Core.
say:6:1320806006:1.source_cn: 这雕像有什么问题吗？当初还是<style=stress...
say:6:1320806006:1.male: What's wrong with it? <style="stress"><player_name></style> even helped to make the Ignis Core.
say:6:1320806006:1.female: What's wrong with it? <style="stress"><player_name></style> even helped to make the Ignis Core.

say:7:1320806007:1.text: Yeah, but I suspect this sculpture wasn't made according to ofﬁcial procedures!
say:7:1320806007:1.source_cn: 没错，但是我怀疑这雕像并不是按照流程制作的！

say:8:1320806008:1.text: Can the quality be assured when the official steps were skipped? Were the best materials used? Are there any flaws in the sculpture's work? Was it erected according to our specifications? What if it collapses and leads to an accident?
say:8:1320806008:1.source_cn: 没按照流程制作的雕像质量有保证吗？用的是最优质的材料吗...

say:10:1320806010:1.text: Not following official procedures is taboo in engineering. So please use your magic to see if the fire inside shows any signs of leaking or dying.
say:10:1320806010:1.source_cn: 不按流程做事是工程学上的大忌，所以拜托你们用魔法检验一...

say:11:1320806011:1.text: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.
say:11:1320806011:1.source_cn: 其他部分我已经查验过了，而魔法的部分，应该没有任何瑕疵...
say:11:1320806011:1.male: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.
say:11:1320806011:1.female: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.

choice_prompt:12:1320806011.text: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.
choice_prompt:12:1320806011.source_cn: 其他部分我已经查验过了，而魔法的部分，应该没有任何瑕疵能逃过<style=stress><player_name></style>的眼睛！
choice_prompt:12:1320806011.male: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.
choice_prompt:12:1320806011.female: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.

say:13:1320806012:1.text: Hahaha! This sculpture represents the living will of the people of Cedartown. We're the ones who crafted it, so we've got to shoulder the responsibility.
say:13:1320806012:1.source_cn: 嚯哈哈哈，这是雪松镇民的精神寄托，制作方——也就是我们...

choice:12:0:1.text: Since you say it like that...
choice:12:0:1.male: Since you say it like that...
choice:12:0:1.female: Since you say it like that...

choice:12:1:2.text: It's not necessary, but since you insist.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 毫无必要，不过如果你坚持
choice:12:1:2.male: It's not necessary, but since you insist.
choice:12:1:2.female: It's not necessary, but since you insist.

say:0:1320808001:0.source_cn: 完美无缺的魔法工艺，完美无缺的雕琢技术。

say:1:1320809001:1.text: So what's the situation with this ice sculpture, Magister?
say:1:1320809001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，这座冰雕的情况怎么样？
say:1:1320809001:1.male: So what's the situation with this ice sculpture, Magister?
say:1:1320809001:1.female: So what's the situation with this ice sculpture, Magister?

choice_prompt:2:1320809001.text: So what's the situation with this ice sculpture, Magister?
choice_prompt:2:1320809001.source_cn: 魔法师大人，这座冰雕的情况怎么样？
choice_prompt:2:1320809001.male: So what's the situation with this ice sculpture, Magister?
choice_prompt:2:1320809001.female: So what's the situation with this ice sculpture, Magister?

say:3:1320809002:1.text: What?! You actually think there isn't a problem?!
say:3:1320809002:1.source_cn: 什么！你竟然觉得没有问题！
say:3:1320809002:1.male: What?! You actually think there isn't a problem?!
say:3:1320809002:1.female: What?! You actually think there isn't a problem?!

say:4:1320809003:1.text: Does that mean I'm being a little nitpicky?
say:4:1320809003:1.source_cn: 难道是我有点吹毛求疵了？

say:6:1320809005:1.text: Hey, for craftsmen, striving for excellence is in our nature.
say:6:1320809005:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，对于工匠来说，精益求精并不全是坏事！

say:7:1320809006:1.text: Sculptures, unlike our other handiwork, need to be out in the field, enduring the elements. There might not be any issues now, but if they aren't made by the proper methods, problems will arise over time.
say:7:1320809006:1.source_cn: 雕像和其他工艺品不一样，需要在野外风吹雨淋，也许现在看...

say:8:1320809007:1.text: But isn't this ice sculpture remade every year for the festival?
say:8:1320809007:1.source_cn: 但是，这位女将军的冰雕不是每年都重新制作吗？

say:9:1320809008:1.text: I'm not talking about this one ice sculpture! I'm talking about the whole process of it all!
say:9:1320809008:1.source_cn: 我说的不只是这一座冰雕，而是指所有的流程！

say:10:1320809009:1.text: New apprentices may question these regulations and rules. But when a project is built from the ground up, adhering to the standard procedures, and it's presented without a hitch before the deadline... That feeling...
say:10:1320809009:1.source_cn: 刚入行的工匠新人，有些会对这些条例和规范狠狠质疑。但，...

say:11:1320809010:1.text: That feeling of accomplishment is indescribable, like a flawless victory after an endless struggle.
say:11:1320809010:1.source_cn: 噢嚯嚯……我永远也忘不了那个瞬间的成就感，那是一场又一...

say:12:1320809011:1.text: Every craftsman in the world is always striving to push their skills to the brink of their abilities just to taste that sweet sensation of triumph once more.
say:12:1320809011:1.source_cn: 这世上所有工匠不断逼着自己做出能力上限的东西，就是为了...

say:13:1320809012:1.text: The best mages also feel the same way...
say:13:1320809012:1.source_cn: 确实优秀的魔法师也会有这样的特质，但……

say:14:1320809013:1.text: So, what are you going to do with the ice sculpture?
say:14:1320809013:1.source_cn: 所以，这雕像你打算怎么办？

say:15:1320809014:1.text: After both <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I did our inspections, it's good enough to meet our standards.
say:15:1320809014:1.male: After both <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I did our inspections, it's good enough to meet our standards.
say:15:1320809014:1.female: After both <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I did our inspections, it's good enough to meet our standards.

say:16:1320809015:1.text: However, the rest of the production process needs to be evaluated. The sculpture was crafted inexplicably, and now many of my brethren are shocked and confused. Do you all want to tag along and take a look?
say:16:1320809015:1.source_cn: 但是还得再观察一下其他生产流程，雕像莫名其妙地做好了，...

say:17:1320809016:1.text: Oh, Chippy wants to go! The ice sculpture was halfway done when we helped earlier. Chippy wants to see how it's made from scratch.
say:17:1320809016:1.source_cn: 满满也想去看看！之前我们帮忙的时候，冰雕已经做到一半了...

say:20:1320809018:1.text: Ha! So, we have a few curious apprentices on our hands!
say:20:1320809018:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，你们就像是刚入行的充满好奇的学徒！

say:21:1320809019:1.text: Alright, let's go to where we are gathering the raw materials, the Luminite Mine. All the ice for sculptures and crafting is mined there.
say:21:1320809019:1.source_cn: 我们先去原材料采集区——冰晶矿洞。制作雕像的冰块都是从...

say:22:1320809020:1.text: We just came from there. Your brethren are unsure if they should continue mining or not since the ice sculpture has already been completed.
say:22:1320809020:1.source_cn: 我们刚刚就是从矿洞来的，你的同胞们正在犹豫要不要继续开...

say:23:1320809021:1.text: I understand. Let's go to the cave together.
say:23:1320809021:1.source_cn: 那正好。你们几个，都跟我来！

say:0:1320810001:0.text: This will definitely be educational. I can't wait to see how real craftsmen work!
say:0:1320810001:0.source_cn: 听起来是很有价值的观察之旅，正好可以了解工匠们是怎么工作的。

say:1:1320812001:1.source_cn: 咦，这里也有工人在开采呢。

say:2:1320812002:1.text: But there's no need to mine anymore...
say:2:1320812002:1.source_cn: 其实已经不用再开采了……

say:3:1320812003:1.text: Alright, let's see what's going on here.
say:3:1320812003:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，我来看看进度如何。

say:5:1320812004:1.text: Are you here to check on our progress? Well, we have no time! We're far behind schedule!
say:5:1320812004:1.source_cn: 来查进度吗？没空！我们的作业进度已经远远落后计划了！

choice_prompt:6:1320812004.text: Are you here to check on our progress? Well, we have no time! We're far behind schedule!
choice_prompt:6:1320812004.source_cn: 来查进度吗？没空！我们的作业进度已经远远落后计划了！

say:7:1320812005:1.text: Are you calling our hard-earned labor unnecessary?!
say:7:1320812005:1.source_cn: 谁敢把我们高尚的劳动称为无用功？！

say:8:1320812007:1.text: Calm down. I think the production is still within the scope of our original designs.
say:8:1320812007:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯嚯，冷静冷静，我看产量还在计划弹性范围内。

say:9:1320812008:1.text: Besides, the magister here can help improve our work productivity, so there's nothing to worry about.
say:9:1320812008:1.source_cn: 而且，我身边这位魔法师能帮助你提升工作效率，没什么可担心的！
say:9:1320812008:1.male: Besides, the magister here can help improve our work productivity, so there's nothing to worry about.
say:9:1320812008:1.female: Besides, the magister here can help improve our work productivity, so there's nothing to worry about.

say:10:1320812009:1.text: Who? Him? But he looks so frail and weak!
say:10:1320812009:1.male: Who? Him? But he looks so frail and weak!
say:10:1320812009:1.female: Who? Her? But she looks so frail and weak!

choice_prompt:11:1320812009.text: Who? Him? But he looks so frail and weak!
choice_prompt:11:1320812009.male: Who? Him? But he looks so frail and weak!
choice_prompt:11:1320812009.female: Who? Her? But she looks so frail and weak!

say:12:1320812010:1.text: Ha! Just watch. Sometimes, you need outside help to get things done if you want everything to be on schedule. Please, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, use your magic to help him.
say:12:1320812010:1.source_cn: 哼，瞧着吧，在必要的时候采取外界助力才能如期完成计划—...
say:12:1320812010:1.male: Ha! Just watch. Sometimes, you need outside help to get things done if you want everything to be on schedule. Please, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, use your magic to help him.
say:12:1320812010:1.female: Ha! Just watch. Sometimes, you need outside help to get things done if you want everything to be on schedule. Please, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, use your magic to help him.

choice:11:0:1.text: Let me show you what I can do.
choice:11:0:1.male: Let me show you what I can do.
choice:11:0:1.female: Let me show you what I can do.

choice:11:1:2.text: Don't underestimate me. You'll regret it.
choice:11:1:2.male: Don't underestimate me. You'll regret it.
choice:11:1:2.female: Don't underestimate me. You'll regret it.

say:14:1320812006:1.text: What?! No one notified us! No official order was passed down to us! If there's no written notice, everything will continue from the original design plan.
say:14:1320812006:1.source_cn: 什么？没人通知我们！没人签字画押，没有正式的变更通知，...

say:1:1320813001:1.text: By death's beard! The whole problem was fixed with just a flick of your wrist!
say:1:1320813001:1.source_cn: 难以置信！你挥挥手就解决了！
say:1:1320813001:1.male: By death's beard! The whole problem was fixed with just a flick of your wrist!
say:1:1320813001:1.female: By death's beard! The whole problem was fixed with just a flick of your wrist!

say:2:1320813002:1.text: Magic is amazing. If it could be included in the mining process...
say:2:1320813002:1.source_cn: 魔法是还挺方便的，哼……要是能放入常规采集流程里……

say:3:1320813003:1.text: Ha! How can you make sure you have a mage on hand every time? Also, Cedartown has a very limited budget. In the end, it'll still come down to our dedication to craftsmanship and our immense love of building things!
say:3:1320813003:1.source_cn: 哈哈！但是怎么保证每次都能雇佣到合适的魔法师？据我所知...

say:4:1320813004:0.text: Yeah, you're right! Magic is nice and all, but I still prefer having a hammer in my hands and banging away at one of our latest projects.
say:4:1320813004:0.source_cn: 哼，你说得对，比起魔法，我更喜欢手握锤柄——咚咚！咣咣...

say:6:1320813005:1.text: I mean, I even dreamed of mining these ice blocks and then carrying them away. It's so strange. In my dreams, I witnessed the entire process of polishing the sculpture, erecting it, and even the lighting ceremony.
say:6:1320813005:1.source_cn: 我甚至做梦都梦到在开凿冰块……然后搬运到加工场所，梦中...

choice_prompt:7:1320813005.text: I mean, I even dreamed of mining these ice blocks and then carrying them away. It's so strange. In my dreams, I witnessed the entire process of polishing the sculpture, erecting it, and even the lighting ceremony.
choice_prompt:7:1320813005.source_cn: 我甚至做梦都梦到在开凿冰块……然后搬运到加工场所，梦中我甚至亲眼目睹了雕像抛光、立起乃至点火成功的全过程……！

say:8:1320813006:1.text: What are you babbling about? It was a dream! I can tell dreams from reality, alright?!
say:8:1320813006:1.source_cn: 说什么呢，梦就是梦！我可不会把梦和现实搞混！

say:9:1320813007:1.text: Anyway, thanks for the help. With this completed, I can go home early and make some snacks for my boy.
say:9:1320813007:1.source_cn: 无论如何，感谢你们。计划完成，我可以早点回去了，我甚至...

say:2:1320814003:0.text: The cry came from the southeast!
say:2:1320814003:0.source_cn: 嚯，这声音是——从东南来的！

say:1:1320816001:1.text: We heard your cries for help. What happened?
say:1:1320816001:1.source_cn: 我们听到了呼救声，怎么回事？

say:2:1320816002:1.text: Oh, that. It was just a beast that broke into the mine to get away from the snow. It wasn't a real cry for help.
say:2:1320816002:1.source_cn: 呼救？一只闯进矿洞避风雪的野兽而已，我还犯不上为这点事呼救！

say:4:1320816003:1.text: Stop acting cocky! If we didn't show up just now, your throat would've been ripped out!
say:4:1320816003:1.source_cn: 说什么大话！刚才我们不来你就被咬断喉咙了！

say:5:1320816004:1.text: Nah, I could've handled it. My pickaxe and hammer are not to be laughed at!
say:5:1320816004:1.source_cn: 没事！我应付得来！我的铁镐和榔头都很有力量！

say:6:1320816005:1.text: Hey, listen up! No matter what happens, safety is our top priority. Emergency response measures are also included in our work manual. Remember that!
say:6:1320816005:1.source_cn: 无论发生什么，安全比什么都重要！突发情况的应对措施也在...

say:7:1320816006:1.text: Understood... But I still have work I need to finish. It can't be delayed any longer.
say:7:1320816006:1.source_cn: 知道了……但是也不能误工！我还有活儿要干，不能再耽搁了！

say:9:1320816007:1.text: *Sigh*... My people are great at what they do. However, sometimes they are too stubborn.
say:9:1320816007:1.source_cn: 呼……我的同胞们哪里都好，就是有时候太钻牛角尖了。

say:10:1320816008:1.text: It's actually a good thing that you realize this.
say:10:1320816008:1.source_cn: 能意识到别人在钻牛角尖，是件好事！

say:11:1320816009:1.text: Ha! I'll take that as a compliment!

say:12:1320816010:1.text: To be on the safe side, I have to go back and remind my colleagues that there are wild animals in the cave and that they need to pay more attention to their safety.
say:12:1320816010:1.source_cn: 安全起见，我得再回去提醒下其他同胞，洞内有野兽出没，他...

say:1:1320817001:1.text: Hey, friend. I noticed that there's been a lot of snow and wind lately. Some wild animals are coming into the cave for shelter.
say:1:1320817001:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，朋友，最近风雪很大，会有野兽来洞内取暖歇息。

say:2:1320817002:1.text: Be careful when you go home, and have whoever comes on the second shift be armed with some weapons for safety.
say:2:1320817002:1.source_cn: 你回家时注意些，让之后换班来采集的人配好武器，保障安全。

say:3:1320817003:1.text: Did you come back just to tell us that?
say:3:1320817003:1.source_cn: 什么？你们是特意赶回来的？

say:4:1320817004:1.text: Alright, thanks. I'm about to call it a day anyway. After I deliver this shipment, I'll go home.
say:4:1320817004:1.source_cn: 我也准备收工了，等把开凿出来的矿石运到冶炼处，我就回家。

say:7:1320817006:1.text: My brethren are so responsible, working until the last moment.
say:7:1320817006:1.source_cn: 我的同胞如此认真负责，坚守到最后一刻。

say:8:1320817007:1.text: Alright, you said you wanted to see how everything works. While a team of craftsmen chips away at the ice, another team makes the metal skeleton that supports the sculpture. We're responsible for the whole process, from melting to casting.
say:8:1320817007:1.source_cn: 好了，你们之前说想参观雕像制作的全流程。一队工匠开凿冰...

say:9:1320817008:1.text: Follow me. It's time for us to return to <style="highlight">Cedartown</style>.

say:0:1320818001:0.text: The production of the metal skeleton happens on Artisan Avenue.
say:0:1320818001:0.source_cn: 金属骨架的生产地在工匠街，你们还记得吧。

say:0:1320818201:0.text: Hey, is anyone going to take a look at this?

say:1:1320818202:0.text: What's going on? What's with the ruckus?
say:1:1320818202:0.source_cn: 怎么回事，怎么吵吵嚷嚷的！

say:1:1320819001:1.text: What happened? Let me take a look...
say:1:1320819001:1.source_cn: 出什么事了，让我来看看……

say:2:1320819002:1.text: Why is the furnace bearing stuck? The pipe is blocked! Who's in charge here?!
say:2:1320819002:1.source_cn: 熔炉的轴承怎么卡住了？管道都堵了！谁是这里的负责人？！

say:3:1320819003:1.text: I-I am. But listen, I just arrived. There was a shift change. I followed standard procedures perfectly.
say:3:1320819003:1.source_cn: 是……是我，但是你听我说！我虽然刚刚来换班，但我是完全...

say:4:1320819004:1.text: What procedure?! Don't you see the pipe is blocked? It's still heating up! If this continues, the furnace will explode!
say:4:1320819004:1.source_cn: 什么流程！你没看到管道堵住了吗？还在加温？这样下去会炸炉！

say:5:1320819005:1.text: But the guy before me said to continue and not to do anything else!
say:5:1320819005:1.source_cn: 但……和我交接的人是这么说的，他告诉我只要按时进料就行...

say:6:1320819006:1.text: What?! All procedures and operations need to stop when there's a possible accident! Safety always comes first!
say:6:1320819006:1.source_cn: 什么？！在可能出现的工程事故面前，任何流程都可以终止与...

say:8:1320819008:1.text: But what?! If you don't properly solve a problem when you see it, what's the point?! You might as well go home and raise sheep, you nincompoop!
say:8:1320819008:1.source_cn: 可是什么？遇到问题不解决问题，一味死板地执行，你还做什...

say:9:1320819009:1.text: Hugin! There's a weird sound coming from the furnace!
say:9:1320819009:1.source_cn: ……呼金，呼金，你听，好像有什么奇怪的声音……

say:10:1320819010:1.text: Ah! The exhaust system is approaching its limits! We need to relieve the pressure right now!
say:10:1320819010:1.source_cn: ——糟糕！排气系统快到阈值了！我们得抓紧泄压！

say:12:1320819012:1.text: Stand aside and just watch! I'll definitely teach you a lesson later!
say:12:1320819012:1.source_cn: 站在一边，看我们操作！一会儿我再教训你！

say:13:1320819013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is an emergency! I need your help!
say:13:1320819013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is an emergency! I need your help!
say:13:1320819013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is an emergency! I need your help!

say:14:1320819014:1.text: I'll start by relieving some of the pressure on the furnace, but to completely solve the problem, we need to make a lubricant to unclog the pipe. Let me think... Oh! We need some <style="highlight">snowgem berries</style> and <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style>!
say:14:1320819014:1.source_cn: 我先给熔炉泄压，要彻底解决问题，需要一种调和润滑剂来疏...

say:15:1320819015:0.text: Also, we need some <style="highlight">bird saliva</style>. That's the special ingredient for the lubricant!

say:16:1320819016:1.text: I loosened the exhaust valve like you requested. There's only the pile-up of ore left...
say:16:1320819016:1.source_cn: 排气阀经按你的要求拧松了，所以剩下堆积的铁矿……

say:17:1320819017:1.text: Alright, don't move a single thing until we get back! Remember! Don't add any more!
say:17:1320819017:1.source_cn: 一颗也不要动，不要再往熔炉里添进哪怕一粒沙子——直到我...

say:0:1320819101:0.text: Everything we need for the lubricant can be found north of Cedartown!
say:0:1320819101:0.source_cn: 润滑油所需的材料在雪松镇以北应该能找到，我们快去快回。

say:1:1320820001:1.source_cn: 呼金，所有材料都集齐了！

say:2:1320820002:1.text: Nice! The exhaust valve was loosened, so the furnace should be able to hold out for a bit.
say:2:1320820002:1.source_cn: 好，我临走前让技工拧松了排气阀，熔炉应该可以撑一阵！

say:3:1320820003:1.text: That technician was still adding ore even after the pipe was clogged. Does he care that much about the official procedures?
say:3:1320820003:1.source_cn: 明明管道都堵塞了但还在按既定流程添加原材料，那位技工未...

say:4:1320820004:1.text: Hmph! One must abide by the rules and be adaptable at the same time. That's what makes a great craftsman! That boy is still too young.
say:4:1320820004:1.source_cn: 哼，既要恪守规则，又要学会灵活变通，这才是值得信赖的工...

say:5:1320820005:1.text: Now that all the ingredients are here, Magister, please mix them according to the recipe.
say:5:1320820005:1.source_cn: 既然材料集齐了——嚯嚯，魔法师大人，拜托你按配方把润滑...
say:5:1320820005:1.male: Now that all the ingredients are here, Magister, please mix them according to the recipe.
say:5:1320820005:1.female: Now that all the ingredients are here, Magister, please mix them according to the recipe.

document:7:112:0.text:
No one understands why these ingredients work as a lubricant, but oddly, when you combine oils from <style="highlight">snowgem berries</style>, <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style> skin extract, and <style="highlight">bird saliva</style> heated to high temperatures, then add a touch of magic, it creates a slightly warm lubricant.

Hold it carefully in your hands, or it's going to slip right out.
document:7:112:0.source_cn:
……谁也不知道这些东西为什么能做成润滑剂，但奇怪的是，<style="highlight">莹霜醋栗</style>榨出的油脂、<style="highlight">血剑果</style>的表皮提取物和<style="highlight">野生鹫鸟的唾液</style>高温萃取，再混入一点魔法，就能做出微微发热的润滑剂。

要小心拿住，别让它从手中滑走！

narration:11:1320820006:0.text: After some time of mixing and blending...

narration:13:1320820006:0.text: After some time of mixing and blending...

say:17:1320820008:1.text: Wonderful! Let's hurry back before that kid makes another mess we need to clean up!
say:17:1320820008:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，好！再不回去，我担心看熔炉那小子又头脑一愣，搞出...

say:1:1320822001:1.text: We're back! You didn't do anything, did you? In times like this, the work manual is useless.
say:1:1320822001:1.source_cn: 我们回来了。你小子没按照工作手册上的条例做多余的事吧。

say:2:1320822002:1.text: No, I listened to you. I stood here all this time. I didn't even move a muscle!
say:2:1320822002:1.source_cn: 没有，我听你的话站在一边，一动也没动！

say:3:1320822003:1.text: When I said not to move a single thing until we get back, I didn't mean you!
say:3:1320822003:1.source_cn: ……我是让你不要做多余的事，没说让你连眼睛也不许眨！

say:4:1320822004:1.text: Alright, go wash up! After I unclog the pipe, it's gonna be a lot of physical labor. So cheer up! You're gonna take charge until the end of your shift!
say:4:1320822004:1.source_cn: 去洗把脸，等我用润滑剂疏通管道之后要做的都是体力活，打...

narration:7:1320822006:1.text: Hugin pours the lubricant into the pipe. Moments later...

say:9:1320822007:1.text: The pipe is flowing nicely again. The furnace should be fine now.
say:9:1320822007:1.source_cn: 管道恢复畅通，这下熔炉应该没问题了。

say:10:1320822008:1.text: Holy hammer! After the pipe was cleared, the furnace heated up so quickly! You sure know a lot about this!
say:10:1320822008:1.source_cn: ……难以置信，管道疏通后熔炉升温这么快！你对熔炉很了解……

say:11:1320822009:1.text: Of course, I made this furnace!
say:11:1320822009:1.source_cn: 当然！这熔炉就是我做的！

say:12:1320822010:1.text: You do know that taking care of a furnace requires a different focus than its operation. Try not to confuse the two.
say:12:1320822010:1.source_cn: 噢嚯嚯，小子，熔炉的养护和操作需要注意的重点不同，你是...

say:13:1320822011:1.text: I ain't confused. It's just that the maintenance procedures are a little too complicated. I can't remember them all. No one taught me during the training or during the shift change.
say:13:1320822011:1.source_cn: 不是我搞混了，是养护流程太复杂了，我记不住……教我交接...

say:14:1320822012:1.text: Thunder and ashes! Thinking that upkeep is trivial and rushing through a task are mistakes that all craftsmen must overcome! There's an old saying, "Sharpening the axe delays not the chopping of wood."
say:14:1320822012:1.source_cn: 哼，以为保养养护的工序不要紧，赶紧把工赶完才最重要——...

say:15:1320822013:1.text: The old maintenance procedures are a bit complicated. I've revised it. Here, I wrote everything down. Take it and make some copies. Have everyone take a look and optimize future procedures from this.
say:15:1320822013:1.source_cn: 老一套的养护流程是有些复杂，我重新起草了一份，你拿回去...

say:18:1320822015:1.text: I didn't expect you to simplify the process.

say:19:1320822016:1.text: Well, no matter how detailed the procedures are written, they're useless if new apprentices can't read them. Especially when some of these novices are disinclined to use their noggins...
say:19:1320822016:1.source_cn: 是啊，流程写的再详细，新人不去看都是白搭，尤其是这种不...

say:22:1320822018:1.text: Ha! If only my younger brethren understood that, my life would be easier...
say:22:1320822018:1.source_cn: 哦嚯嚯，要是我那些年轻的同胞也能明白这点就好了！

say:23:1320822021:1.text: Well, I agree with what Hugin said earlier. Having a good set of standard procedures is important, but it also makes sense to get people up to speed faster.
say:23:1320822021:1.source_cn: 嗯，我也赞同呼金说的，虽然能理解合理的流程，但怎样让人...

say:24:1320822022:1.text: Truth be told, I'm a little worried about the next line of production. I can't fathom what mischief the new apprentices might brew in the days ahead.
say:24:1320822022:1.source_cn: 实话说，我有点担心下个生产线了，不知道现在雕琢加工的学...

choice:21:0:1.text: The process must serve the outcome.
choice:21:0:1.male: The process must serve the outcome.
choice:21:0:1.female: The process must serve the outcome.

say:26:1320822019:1.text: Ha! Mages and craftsmen definitely think differently! However, you guys do always come up with the most unexpected designs.
say:26:1320822019:1.source_cn: 哼，魔法师和工匠的思路永远不对付！但是真奇怪，你们却总...

choice:21:1:2.text: Forget the process. Just do it right!
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 管什么流程，做好就行了！
choice:21:1:2.male: Forget the process. Just do it right!
choice:21:1:2.female: Forget the process. Just do it right!

say:27:1320822020:1.text: Just a short while before. I can't recall exactly how many years. See! Even the work manual they're using here is still the first edition. If I stayed here longer, I'd have written a dozen more editions!
say:27:1320822020:1.source_cn: 一小段时间。具体多少年记不清了，你看，连这里工匠用的工...
say:27:1320822020:1.male: Just a short while before. I can't recall exactly how many years. See! Even the work manual they're using here is still the first edition. If I stayed here longer, I'd have written a dozen more editions!
say:27:1320822020:1.female: Just a short while before. I can't recall exactly how many years. See! Even the work manual they're using here is still the first edition. If I stayed here longer, I'd have written a dozen more editions!

choice:21:2:3.text: How long did you stay in Cedartown before?
choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 你之前在雪松镇待了多久？
choice:21:2:3.male: How long did you stay in Cedartown before?
choice:21:2:3.female: How long did you stay in Cedartown before?

say:0:1320823001:0.text: The carving happens at the end of Artisan Avenue.
say:0:1320823001:0.source_cn: 雕刻作业区在工匠街尽头，往里走！

say:0:1320825001:0.text: It looks pretty organized, but I wonder if that really is the case.
say:0:1320825001:0.source_cn: 看起来还算井井有条，不过实际上真是这样吗？

say:1:1320825002:0.text: A craftsman's tools can reveal a lot. Let's look around.
say:1:1320825002:0.source_cn: 工匠的工具会暴露许多秘密，我们到处看看。

say:1:1320826001:1.text: Strange... this set of tools isn't complete. The bevel knife is missing.
say:1:1320826001:1.source_cn: 奇怪，这里的雕刻刀不是整套，斜刀缺失了。

say:2:1320826002:1.text: Maybe it was placed somewhere else?
say:2:1320826002:1.source_cn: 被工匠放在别的地方了？

say:3:1320826003:1.text: For sculptors, their knives are an extension of their body. How could they be left lying around?!
say:3:1320826003:1.source_cn: 刻刀对于雕刻匠人来说，就如同自己手臂的延伸，怎么能随手乱放！

say:4:1320826004:1.text: Would you leave your arms and legs at home when you leave the house? Plus, this knife even has a name. It's Danica, by the way.
say:4:1320826004:1.source_cn: 你们会把自己的手臂或者腿脚拆下来放到别处去吗？何况她有...

choice_prompt:5:1320826004.text: Would you leave your arms and legs at home when you leave the house? Plus, this knife even has a name. It's Danica, by the way.
choice_prompt:5:1320826004.source_cn: 你们会把自己的手臂或者腿脚拆下来放到别处去吗？何况她有自己的名字，叫丹妮卡！

say:6:1320826005:1.text: Leaving tools lying around is an abomination. The owner needs a good talking-to!
say:6:1320826005:1.source_cn: 随手乱放工具是可憎的陋习，得叫这套工具的所有者来——

say:8:1320826006:1.text: What's going on? What's with all the ruckus here?!
say:8:1320826006:1.source_cn: 怎么了怎么了，这么晚不要在作业区吵闹！

say:9:1320826007:1.text: I'm making all the ruckus! How are you going to get the details of the sculpture without a full set of tools?
say:9:1320826007:1.source_cn: 是我，你的工具没成套。雕像的关节角落和镂空处你准备怎么修光？

say:10:1320826008:1.text: Oh, Master Hugin! I'm sorry I didn't see you there!

say:11:1320826009:1.text: Don't try and be polite with me! I don't know anyone who would leave their tools just lying around!
say:11:1320826009:1.source_cn: 别叫我老师，我没带过会随意丢置工具的学徒。

say:12:1320826010:1.text: And what's that smell? Have you been drinking?
say:12:1320826010:1.source_cn: 你那是什么口气？你喝酒了？

say:13:1320826011:1.text: I-I just went to the tavern and had a few brews...
say:13:1320826011:1.source_cn: 我……我去酒馆喝了点黑麦酒……

say:14:1320826012:1.text: Well, you smell terrible! You know that you can't work on these masterpieces when you're under the influence.
say:14:1320826012:1.source_cn: 哼，醉醺醺的，一身酒气！过度饮酒会让你失去肢体控制，发...

say:15:1320826013:1.text: You're not allowed to do any more work until you sober up! Go dunk yourself in a tub of ice water! I want you awake and alert!
say:15:1320826013:1.source_cn: 彻底醒酒之前，你不能再做任何工作。去找桶冰水从头到脚浇...

say:18:1320826015:1.text: Been a few years since I was last here. I can't believe how much the quality of craftsmen on Artisan Avenue has nosedived!
say:18:1320826015:1.source_cn: 几年没来，工匠街的人竟然如此堕落了！

choice_prompt:19:1320826015.text: Been a few years since I was last here. I can't believe how much the quality of craftsmen on Artisan Avenue has nosedived!
choice_prompt:19:1320826015.source_cn: 几年没来，工匠街的人竟然如此堕落了！

say:20:1320826016:1.text: How can we trust someone who shirks his duties to lounge at the tavern with the crucial task of crafting the ice sculptures?!
say:20:1320826016:1.source_cn: 为了放松娱乐，连自己的本质工作都抛于脑后，这样的人怎么...

say:21:1320826017:1.text: *Sigh*... Let me just calm down for a moment. I'm guessing that idiot probably left his bevel knife at the tavern.
say:21:1320826017:1.source_cn: 呼……让我喘口气。那小子去痛饮，可能把雕刻刀丢在酒馆了。

say:22:1320826018:1.text: It's an irreplaceable tool for any craftsman. It must be retrieved.
say:22:1320826018:1.source_cn: 那是工匠宝贵的工具，无论如何，得找回来。

choice:19:0:1.text: It's rare to see you lose your temper.
choice:19:0:1.male: It's rare to see you lose your temper.
choice:19:0:1.female: It's rare to see you lose your temper.

choice:5:0:1.text: We can't take our arms off.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 我们卸不下自己的手臂！
choice:5:0:1.male: We can't take our arms off.
choice:5:0:1.female: We can't take our arms off.

choice:5:1:2.text: Only you can replace your limbs.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 只有你可以卸下自己的腿！
choice:5:1:2.male: Only you can replace your limbs.
choice:5:1:2.female: Only you can replace your limbs.

choice:5:2:3.text: Ah, a new name has appeared...
choice:5:2:3.male: Ah, a new name has appeared...
choice:5:2:3.female: Ah, a new name has appeared...

say:0:1320827001:0.text: Young people nowadays are really incompetent!
say:0:1320827001:0.source_cn: 现在的年轻人，真是不成器！

say:1:1320827002:0.text: Let's just hope the knife is still at the tavern!
say:1:1320827002:0.source_cn: 只能期望丢失的雕刻刀还留在酒馆了！

say:0:1320828001:0.text: This knife is kind of weird.

say:1:1320828002:0.text: Look! Is that the bevel knife?
say:1:1320828002:0.source_cn: 看呀，那是不是丢失的雕刻刀？

say:1:1320829001:1.text: Hey, young fella! Did you find that bevel knife in the tavern?
say:1:1320829001:1.source_cn: 喂！小伙子！你手里的雕刻刀，是在酒馆捡到的吗？

say:4:1320829002:0.text: Bevel knife? I thought it was a knife for skinning. The shape is a bit weird.
say:4:1320829002:0.source_cn: 雕刻刀？这不是剥皮刀吗？虽然造型奇怪了点。

say:5:1320829003:1.text: If you look closely at the blade of the knife, you'll see that it's raised differently.
say:5:1320829003:1.source_cn: 你仔细看那把刀的刀头，凸起的刀刃形状各个不一样！

say:6:1320829004:1.text: It's designed for carving and sculpting at different angles. If you use it to skin an animal, the blade will be damaged, and the skin on the fur will lacerate.
say:6:1320829004:1.source_cn: 是为了在不同角度进行精细的雕琢，如果你拿去剥皮，刀刃会...

say:7:1320829005:1.text: Hey, I'm the one that found it! What I do with it is my business! I think the knife is fine for skinning a few rabbits.
say:7:1320829005:1.source_cn: 但这是我捡到的……！要怎么用是我的事！我看它好得很，剥...

say:8:1320829006:1.text: Gah! You youngsters are always breaking the rules! How can a bevel knife be used to skin animals?!
say:8:1320829006:1.source_cn: 啧，你们总是在这种事上打破规矩，刻刀怎么能用来剥皮呢……！

say:9:1320829007:1.text: You must not be the one doing the hunting, right?
say:9:1320829007:1.source_cn: 我知道了，狩猎的一定不是你吧？

say:10:1320829008:1.text: Yeah, my father does the hunting.

say:11:1320829009:1.text: I knew it. You don't hunt yourself, so you can't grasp the frustration when all your hard work gets spoiled by someone else.
say:11:1320829009:1.source_cn: 这就对了，你不是亲自狩猎的人，所以不知道付出辛劳后的收...

say:12:1320829010:1.text: For you, this knife can be used however you want. But for a sculptor, it's a very important tool.
say:12:1320829010:1.source_cn: 对于你来说这把刀的确怎么用都行，但对于雕工来说，这是重...

say:13:1320829011:1.text: My people have been working with Danica for centuries. She's like our own flesh and blood. Changing partners now, before the job's done, will wreak havoc on our final product!
say:13:1320829011:1.source_cn: 我的族人已经和丹妮卡合作上百年，她就像我们的孩子一样，...

say:15:1320829013:1.text: That bevel knife in your hand.
say:15:1320829013:1.source_cn: 你手里这把刻刀，确切地说，是斜刀。

say:16:1320829014:1.text: You used it for centuries? And you have a name for it?
say:16:1320829014:1.source_cn: 用……用了上百年？而且你……你怎么称呼它？

say:17:1320829015:1.text: Danica is still a young, spirited girl. She's just unhappy to be in your hands right now!
say:17:1320829015:1.source_cn: 怎么，丹妮卡还年轻得很，是个很有精神的小姑娘，而且很不...

say:18:1320829016:1.text: This knife has a girl's name... Either I'm going crazy, or you're really crazy.
say:18:1320829016:1.source_cn: 疯了……管这么一把刀叫姑娘……不是我疯了就是你疯了。

say:19:1320829017:1.text: I want nothing to do with this weird old knife. Here! Take it back!
say:19:1320829017:1.source_cn: 上百年的旧刀，我也不想用，你们想要那就拿回去！

say:21:1320829018:1.text: Yay! We got the knife back!
say:21:1320829018:1.source_cn: 总算把雕刻刀拿回来了！

say:22:1320829019:1.text: If this set of tools is centuries old...
say:22:1320829019:1.source_cn: 竟然连一套刀具都用了上百年……

choice_prompt:23:1320829019.text: If this set of tools is centuries old...
choice_prompt:23:1320829019.source_cn: 竟然连一套刀具都用了上百年……

say:24:1320829020:1.text: I was too busy admiring Danica. What are you all talking about? Oh, I just gave her a good oil down, too.
say:24:1320829020:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，你们在说什么？我给丹妮卡好好保养了一番，用了上好...

say:25:1320829021:1.text: Anyway, let's escort this beautiful girl home.
say:25:1320829021:1.source_cn: 走，该送这小姑娘回家了。

choice:23:2:3.text: Let's not ask about someone's age.
choice:23:2:3.source_cn: 好了，别试图打听别人的年龄
choice:23:2:3.male: Let's not ask about someone's age.
choice:23:2:3.female: Let's not ask about someone's age.

say:0:1320830001:0.text: So this knife... I mean, Danica, was her name chosen for a reason, or was it random?
say:0:1320830001:0.source_cn: 所以这把刀……我是说，丹妮卡，这名字是被锻造出来时取的...

say:1:1320831001:1.text: You're darn lucky that we found your bevel knife!
say:1:1320831001:1.source_cn: 算你运气好，雕刻刀被我们找到了！

say:2:1320831002:1.text: Yes, Master Hugin. I'm awake and alert now.
say:2:1320831002:1.source_cn: 嗯……呼金老师，我现在清醒了。

say:3:1320831003:1.text: Really? Seems to me you still have a long way to go!

say:4:1320831004:1.text: Take care of Danica. She was upset when you lost your way. She loved being held by you. She said your hands were once clean and steady. The real hands of a craftsman, she said, but then you started going to the tavern...
say:4:1320831004:1.source_cn: 照顾好丹妮卡，她和你走丢的时候很不安。她喜欢被你的手持...

choice_prompt:5:1320831004.text: Take care of Danica. She was upset when you lost your way. She loved being held by you. She said your hands were once clean and steady. The real hands of a craftsman, she said, but then you started going to the tavern...
choice_prompt:5:1320831004.source_cn: 照顾好丹妮卡，她和你走丢的时候很不安。她喜欢被你的手持握——她说你的手曾经干净又稳定，是一双工匠的手，而不该去拿酒瓶！

say:6:1320831005:1.source_cn: 这可能很难，但我会尽量克制！

say:9:1320831011:1.text: So you start by melting the ice blocks on Artisan Avenue, and then you move to the processing area to shape and carve the ice sculpture...
say:9:1320831011:1.source_cn: 所以你们在工匠街熔炼开采出的矿石，然后在作业区对冰雕原...

say:10:1320831012:1.text: So, how was the ice sculpture transported to the lighting ceremony? It's huge.
say:10:1320831012:1.source_cn: 那么，最后冰雕是怎样运送到目的地的呢？那座雕像那么巨大！

say:11:1320831013:1.text: To make the deadline, we craft the finished product in sections before joining 'em. Once a part's ready, it's shipped to where the sculpture is to be erected. Once all pieces arrive, it's time to put the whole thing together.
say:11:1320831013:1.source_cn: 哦，为了赶工期，我们会将成品分块雕刻后再组装，一旦有某...

say:12:1320831014:1.text: What about the transport team? When do they arrive?

say:14:1320831015:1.text: They should've left as planned and should be here soon.
say:14:1320831015:1.source_cn: 他们应该已经按计划出发了，在来的路上。

say:15:1320831016:1.text: Hmph! Then they're about to be late. Is the transportation route still the same as before?
say:15:1320831016:1.source_cn: 哼，那他们快要迟到了。运输路线还和以前一样吗？

say:16:1320831017:1.text: No, the transport team said they found a better route and improved the transportation process. They're now taking the riverfront route on the <style="highlight">south side of Cedartown</style>. They'll be coming over the bridge on the southwest side.
say:16:1320831017:1.source_cn: 不，运输队优化了路线，他们现在改走<style=hig...

say:17:1320831018:1.text: The southern riverfront route...? That's the long way! Taking the mountain road on the east side and crossing the flower fields is the shortest distance.
say:17:1320831018:1.source_cn: 南侧的河岸线……？他们绕路了，走镇东侧的山路、穿越花海...

say:18:1320831019:1.text: I've combed over all procedures, processes, and routes. Each has its own problems. I hope that the transport team knows what they're doing with this "improvement" of theirs!
say:18:1320831019:1.source_cn: 关键节点上的其他流程我都已经检查过了，各有各的问题。希...

say:20:1320831020:1.text: This seems to be the last part of the operation that needs to be checked.
say:20:1320831020:1.source_cn: 听起来，这好像是要检查的最后环节了。

say:21:1320831021:1.text: Then let's go to the southwestern side of Cedartown and wait for them at the bridge!
say:21:1320831021:1.source_cn: 那我们去雪松镇西南侧的桥上等他们吧！

choice:5:0:1.text: Spend less time at the tavern.
choice:5:0:1.male: Spend less time at the tavern.
choice:5:0:1.female: Spend less time at the tavern.

say:27:1320831008:1.text: Of course. Master Hugin, I sincerely apologize for my behavior. I am inexperienced and far from standing on my own.
say:27:1320831008:1.source_cn: 应该的……老师……我还太青涩，离独当一面还差得远。

say:28:1320831009:1.text: That's more like it. A true craftsman views himself as a work in progress, always improving, scrutinizing myself, and toiling away until everything is perfect.
say:28:1320831009:1.source_cn: 哼，这话还差不多。优秀的工匠要将自己视作一件永远需要打...

say:1:1320838001:1.text: Ha! You all made it in time!

say:2:1320838002:1.text: I'm curious to know what prompted you to alter the route on the original plan.
say:2:1320838002:1.source_cn: 我很想知道，是什么原因让你们变更了原定计划上的路线。

say:3:1320838003:1.text: Oh, hey, Master Hugin! Weren't you checking on the ice sculpture earlier? What are you doing here?
say:3:1320838003:1.source_cn: 呼金老师，你不是去检查冰雕情况了吗，怎么来了？

say:4:1320838004:1.text: I'm making my rounds across all parts of the operation and inspecting the production lines. The work ethic and the way the procedures are handled were a downright disaster!
say:4:1320838004:1.source_cn: 我顺便检查了所有的产线，无论工作态度，还是对流程的处理...

say:5:1320838005:1.text: Anyway, back to my question. Among all, your team was the only one who strayed from the original plan and altered the transport route. I'm curious why you did that?
say:5:1320838005:1.source_cn: 这么多人中只有你们没有按照原本的计划进行，变更了运输路...

say:6:1320838006:1.text: Oh, yeah. It's because during one of our earlier trips, we noticed that the temperature in Whiteridge has warmed up compared to decades past, so the river isn't fully frozen anymore.
say:6:1320838006:1.source_cn: 喔，是的，因为实际运输中，我们发现白山的气温较几十年前...

say:7:1320838007:1.text: Delivery can be made much more efficient if it's done by ship.
say:7:1320838007:1.source_cn: 如果用船运的话，可以大大提高运输的效率！

say:8:1320838008:1.text: Of course, we've tested this route many times over already. Our test reports have been compiled and filed and are fully compliant with the project.
say:8:1320838008:1.source_cn: 当然，这条路线我们已经测试很多次了，测试报告都整理归档...

say:9:1320838009:1.text: Hahaha! That was a very good idea! I support innovation!
say:9:1320838009:1.source_cn: ……嚯哈哈哈哈！你的想法非常好！如果没问题的话我支持你！

say:10:1320838010:1.text: Really? We were so worried that you wouldn't approve of our modification.
say:10:1320838010:1.source_cn: 真的吗？我们还担心你不愿修改流程呢！

say:11:1320838011:1.text: Had it been me before, I might've been resistant to the idea, but through this inspection, I've come to understand a few things.
say:11:1320838011:1.source_cn: 如果是之前的我，也许会非常抗拒，但通过这次全方位的检查...

say:12:1320838012:1.text: Merely adhering to procedures is empty. Design and creation are about ceaselessly learning, refining, and enhancing. The greatest inventions in the world are shaped by small, ingenious steps.
say:12:1320838012:1.source_cn: 纯粹遵循流程的重复毫无意义，设计就是要不断地汲取更多的...

say:13:1320838013:1.text: If this route proves effective and makes sense, then don't hesitate to forge ahead! The guidelines I've left behind are a few years old, and it's high time we make some tweaks to keep up-to-date.
say:13:1320838013:1.source_cn: 所以，如果这条路线可行且合理，那么就不要顾忌地推进！我...

say:14:1320838014:1.text: Don't worry, Master Hugin. My team and I will do a good job.
say:14:1320838014:1.source_cn: 放心吧，老师，我和这些小伙子们会做好工作。

say:16:1320838015:1.text: Alright, everyone! Keep up! We still need to get to our final destination!
say:16:1320838015:1.source_cn: 好了，大家跟上，我们要按时赶到作业区！

say:19:1320838017:1.text: I didn't expect you to say that, Hugin.
say:19:1320838017:1.source_cn: 哎呀，想不到呼金你也开始变通了嘛。

say:20:1320838018:1.text: Well, in fact, as far back as Rustport, working with <style="stress"><player_name></style> made me realize that listening to others is the first step to progress.
say:20:1320838018:1.source_cn: 其实早在锈锚港的时候。和<style=stress><...
say:20:1320838018:1.male: Well, in fact, as far back as Rustport, working with <style="stress"><player_name></style> made me realize that listening to others is the first step to progress.
say:20:1320838018:1.female: Well, in fact, as far back as Rustport, working with <style="stress"><player_name></style> made me realize that listening to others is the first step to progress.

say:21:1320838019:1.text: A good discussion outshines working alone any day, and sometimes inspiration can only be born when ideas collide.
say:21:1320838019:1.source_cn: 沟通远比闭门造车自己研究的效率要高得多，有时候灵感的火...

say:22:1320838020:1.text: Speaking of which, all these procedures: mining ice blocks, manuals for melting down ice, and our transport routes... I developed them <style="highlight">ninety years ago</style>. I think it's time to update them.
say:22:1320838020:1.source_cn: 说起来，所有这些流程——开凿冰块的注意事项，熔炼手册，...

say:23:1320838021:1.text: I reckon I need to go back now to have a good talk with Haldor and the others. Oh, yeah, and I'll also call in a few smart youngsters as well.
say:23:1320838021:1.source_cn: 说干就干，我现在就回去和老约恩他们一起开讨论会！噢，也...

say:26:1320838024:1.text: Ha! I'm taking that secret to my grave!
